metadata.description: Crypto founders database merged from LinkedIn scrape + web research

founders.name: JB Graftieaux
founders.origin: French. Based in Luxembourg. Full name: Jean-Baptiste Graftieaux.
founders.background: 20+ years in payments and financial services. Spent over a decade at PayPal and eBay, rising to Managing Director of eBay Europe where he led regulatory operations for payments. Also held roles at Montblanc, Accenture, and Landsbankinn (Icelandic bank). First joined Bitstamp in 2014-2016 as Chief Compliance Officer, where he obtained the first regulated crypto exchange license in the EU. Rejoined as Europe CEO in May 2021, then promoted to Global CEO in May 2022.
founders.latest_projects: Led Bitstamp through its acquisition by Robinhood Markets, which closed on June 2, 2025 for approximately $200 million in cash. Bitstamp continues operating with 50+ active licenses and registrations globally, now serving as Robinhood's institutional crypto platform and smart order routing engine across EU, UK, US, and Asia.

founders.name: Joseph Terrigno
founders.background: Data Scientist at Sommelier Protocol (predecessor project). Co-founded Veda in March 2024 alongside Sunand Raghupathi (CEO) and Stephanie Vaughan (COO), all former core contributors at Sommelier Finance where they spent 3+ years building vault-based products that reached $100M TVL.
founders.latest_projects: Veda raised an $18M Series A in June 2025 led by CoinFund, Coinbase Ventures, and Animoca Brands. The platform now manages $3.7B+ across its vault infrastructure, providing enterprise-grade cross-chain yield products.

founders.name: Sunand Raghupathi
founders.origin: United States. Attended Fordham College at Rose Hill (B.S.) and Columbia University (B.S.).
founders.background: Left a computer science PhD program to build in DeFi. Research positions at Mila (Quebec AI Institute), Columbia University, Rochester Institute of Technology, and the Department of Energy's National Renewable Energy Laboratory. Served as Head of Research and Development at Sommelier Protocol before co-founding Veda as CEO.
founders.latest_projects: Leading Veda as CEO, growing the platform to $3.7B+ TVL across enterprise-grade cross-chain yield vaults. Raised $18M Series A in June 2025.

founders.name: Brian Smith
founders.origin: United States. B.S. in Business Administration (Accounting and Finance) from Georgetown University (2007-2011).
founders.background: Spent a decade in traditional finance. Restructuring Analyst at Evercore and Miller Buckfire. Senior Analyst at Scopia Capital Management (multibillion-dollar hedge fund) focused on distressed credit and high yield bonds (2014-2021). Entered Solana DeFi in early 2021. COO at Jito Labs from October 2022 to October 2024, then became Executive Director (President) of the Jito Foundation in October 2024.
founders.latest_projects: Leading the Jito Foundation overseeing JitoSOL (liquid staking), restaking initiatives, and MEV tooling. Jito received a $50M strategic investment from a16z crypto in October 2025. Partnered with FalconX to bring staking returns and MEV rewards to institutional traders. 21Shares launched a JitoSOL staking ETP (JSOL) on Euronext in January 2026.

founders.name: Darren Langley
founders.origin: Holds a B.Sc. from the University of Kent (UK). Currently based in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.
founders.background: Senior .NET Developer at CMC Markets. Senior Software Engineer and Architect at Tabcorp. Technical leadership roles at Victoria State Government Education and Training. Solutions Architect at Queensland Department of Education (cloud-based IAM and Azure). Senior Blockchain Consultant at Civic Ledger. Joined Rocket Pool as Senior Blockchain Developer, then became General Manager.
founders.latest_projects: Leading the Saturn upgrade, Rocket Pool's major protocol release scheduled for February 18, 2026. Saturn introduces Megapools (leveraging EIP-4788 to manage multiple validators from a single smart contract), halves the node operator ETH requirement to 4 ETH, and introduces on-chain voting governance.

founders.name: Michael Schwartz
founders.age_raw: Unknown. Note: This is Obol (cash flow management), not Obol Network (Ethereum DVT).
founders.background: Co-Founder & CEO of Obol (cash flow management platform). Attended Tel Aviv University. NOTE: The crypto Obol Network (DVT) was founded by Collin Myers and Oisin Kyne.
founders.flag_note: This is Obol (cash flow mgmt), not Obol Network (Ethereum DVT). Obol Network founded by Collin Myers & Oisin Kyne.

founders.name: Aviv Sadra
founders.background: Co-Founder of Obol (cash flow platform). Educated at University of Sydney. NOTE: The crypto Obol Network was founded by Collin Myers and Oisin Kyne.
founders.flag_note: This is Obol (cash flow mgmt), not Obol Network (Ethereum DVT).

founders.name: Collin Myers
founders.origin: Based in Switzerland. B.S. in Business Administration from University of Redlands (2009-2013), with studies at the University of Edinburgh (2012) in Global Economics and International Business.
founders.background: Associate in Corporate and Investment Banking at MUFG (2016-2018). Joined ConsenSys where he created the Activate product, led DeFi strategy for CodeFi, and contributed to Eth2 by co-creating the Eth2 Validator Launchpad and helping launch the Genesis event. Founded Obol Labs in 2021 to build Distributed Validator Technology (DVT).
founders.latest_projects: Obol Network securing $975M+ worth of ETH across 300+ unique node operators. Launched the OBOL token with staking and governance features. Partnered with Nethermind to build Pluto (second DVT client, launching 2026). Blockdaemon and ParaFi Tech integrating Obol DVT into Lido's Curated Module. Pendle integrated stOBOL in Q4 2025. Collin Myers has also moved on to co-found Olena Capital.

founders.name: Austin Federa
founders.background: Spent nearly four years at Solana Labs and Foundation as Head of Strategy, becoming one of Solana's most recognizable public figures and spokespeople. Departed the Solana Foundation in late 2024 to co-found DoubleZero alongside Mateo Ward and Andrew McConnell.
founders.latest_projects: DoubleZero raised $28M at a $400M valuation in early 2025 (led by Dragonfly and Multicoin Capital). Built a global fiber optic network optimized for blockchain, connecting 7+ cities with 200 Gbps links. Mainnet-beta launched October 2025 with 22% of staked SOL on the network. Launched a $537M SOL stake pool in July 2025.

founders.name: David McIntyre
founders.origin: United States. Attended Tufts University. Based in Portland, Maine.
founders.background: Worked in Sales at Twitter and Square. Sales Strategy and Operations at Brex and Square. Led Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) at the Solana Foundation before joining DoubleZero as COO.
founders.latest_projects: Serving as COO of DoubleZero, overseeing operations for the global fiber network infrastructure across 7+ cities worldwide.

founders.name: Vipal Karavadra
founders.background: Founder of Fluid (Commercial Finance Brokers), a UK brokerage. NOTE: DeFi 'Fluid' was built by Instadapp founders Samyak & Sowmay Jain.
founders.flag_note: This is Fluid (UK commercial finance broker), not DeFi Fluid. DeFi Fluid built by Instadapp (Samyak & Sowmay Jain).

founders.name: Sowmay Jain & Samyak Jain
founders.background: Both brothers dropped out of college in India -- Samyak from engineering and Sowmay from a Chartered Accountancy program. Founded Instadapp in 2018 at the ETHIndia Hackathon. Backed by Naval Ravikant, Pantera Capital, and Coinbase Ventures. Sowmay was recognized on Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia.
founders.latest_projects: Fluid grew to $3.2B TVL in 2025 with DEX v2 upgrades, establishing itself as a major DeFi liquidity layer deployed across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, and other chains.

founders.name: Jaye T
founders.background: Jaye Tan, co-founder of Sanctum (Solana liquid staking). Educated at University of Oxford. Co-founders include FP Lee (CEO) and Jesse Cho.

founders.name: Jaye T (Jaye Tan)
founders.origin: Singapore-based. Holds an LLB from the National University of Singapore.
founders.background: Co-founded Sanctum in 2021 alongside FP Lee (CEO, who designed Solana's original stake account contracts) and Jesse Cho. Jaye Tan serves as a legal expert and core contributor to Sanctum Labs.
founders.latest_projects: Sanctum's Infinity Pool (INF) leads Solana LST yields at ~7.1% APY, aggregating 200+ LSTs. CLOUD governance token launched. Sanctum v2 expanded beyond staking into Solana's transaction-delivery layer with Gateway (a transaction delivery aggregator built on their Ironforge acquisition).

founders.name: Nathan Allman
founders.origin: United States. B.A. in Economics and Biology from Brown University. MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business.
founders.background: Associate at Prospect Capital Management (alternative assets). Launched a crypto hedge fund (2018-2019). Joined Goldman Sachs' digital assets team in mid-2019, working on security tokens and blockchain projects. Co-founded Ondo Finance.
founders.latest_projects: SEC closed its two-year investigation into Ondo in November 2025 without charges. Met with SEC Crypto Task Force. Partnered with State Street and Galaxy for a $200M tokenized fund (SWEEP, launching 2026). Launched Ondo Perps (24/7 equity perpetual futures). Ondo Chain (permissioned L1 for regulated RWA trading) planned for February 2026. Hit $3B market cap.

founders.name: Brendan Florez
founders.origin: United States. B.S. in Electrical Engineering and Neuroscience from Princeton University (2001-2005).
founders.background: Senior Relationship Manager at Bridgewater Associates. Founded and served as CEO of Base Capital (edtech/fintech). President and COO at Polyera Corporation. Managing Director and Head of Portfolio Operations at Centinel Management (ESG-focused PE/venture).
founders.latest_projects: Serving as Managing Director at Ondo Finance, helping drive institutional adoption of tokenized real-world assets and the Ondo Chain launch.

founders.name: Mark Phillips
founders.background: Senior Finance Manager at Thermo Fisher Scientific. Co-founded Steakhouse Financial with Sebastien Derivaux. Pioneer in blockchain-based financial reporting.
founders.latest_projects: Steakhouse launched Grove, a Sky SubDAO for institutional credit infrastructure, which has deployed $2B+ into credit opportunities including $1B into the Janus Henderson Anemoy JAAA Fund. Steakhouse vaults reached nine-figure levels on Solana.

founders.name: Sébastien Derivaux
founders.age_raw: ~45 (PhD started 2005 at Université Louis Pasteur Strasbourg)
founders.background: Co-Founder/Partner at Steakhouse Financial. PhD in CS (Data Mining) from Université Louis Pasteur (2005-2009). Former Head of Real-World Finance at MakerDAO.

founders.name: Sebastien Derivaux
founders.origin: French. Based in Strasbourg, France. Attended Louis Pasteur University (now University of Strasbourg).
founders.background: Joined MakerDAO in 2020, leading Real-World Asset (RWA) efforts as Head of Real-World Finance. Pioneered RWA integration into DeFi. Also serves as a main curator for the Morpho lending and borrowing protocol.
founders.latest_projects: Co-leading Steakhouse Financial's Grove initiative (Sky SubDAO deploying $2B+ into institutional credit). Active curator on Morpho. Advising on stablecoin design and DeFi risk management.

founders.name: Martin Quensel
founders.origin: Germany (based in Berlin). Entrepreneur and angel investor.
founders.background: Started career at SAP as software developer and architect. Founded M+M Software (acquired by SAP). Co-founded Taulia (supply chain finance network serving 120+ Global 2000 companies). Co-founded Centrifuge in 2017. 20+ years in finance and IT.
founders.latest_projects: Centrifuge now manages $1.37B in tokenized assets. Janus Henderson AAA CLO strategy (JAAA) brought on-chain with $1B allocation from Grove. Launched Whitelabel tokenization service (November 2025). New leadership: Bhaji Illuminati as CEO, with Quensel focused on protocol strategy.

founders.name: Lucas Vogelsang
founders.origin: Swiss. Attended Kantonsschule Hohe Promenade (Zurich). Dropped out of university to pursue startups. Spent 6 years in Silicon Valley.
founders.background: Co-founded DeinDeal (Swiss e-commerce startup, Groupon competitor) as CTO -- acquired in 2011. Early engineer at Taulia (acquired by SAP in 2022). Co-founded Centrifuge in 2017, becoming first DeFi protocol to bring RWAs on-chain in 2020.
founders.latest_projects: Joined Blockchain Capital as Venture Partner (announced February 2026). Centrifuge's V3 architecture with ERC-7540 compatibility launched, enabling multichain RWA liquidity.

founders.name: John Morrow
founders.background: Product, engineering, and operations at Microsoft and Goldman Sachs. Expertise in quantitative trading, HFT, marketplace design, and simulation. Co-founded Gauntlet with Tarun Chitra in 2018 as COO.
founders.latest_projects: Gauntlet evolved from protocol risk consultants to direct vault operators. Three vault risk tiers: Prime, Core, Frontier. Absorbed $775M in a single transaction in October 2025.

founders.name: Tarun Chitra
founders.origin: United States (grew up in Wilmington, Delaware). Attended Charter School of Wilmington, then Cornell University (B.A. Mathematics, B.S. Applied Engineering Physics, 2007-2011).
founders.background: Worked at AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals. Background in high-frequency trading and scientific programming at Vatic Labs and D. E. Shaw Research. Founded Gauntlet in June 2018. Forbes 30 Under 30 Finance (2022). Published pioneering peer-reviewed papers on economic security of Uniswap and Compound.
founders.latest_projects: Leading Gauntlet's transformation into the largest vault curator on Morpho ($700M+ managed). 80+ vaults across 6+ chains. Also runs Robot Ventures (crypto venture fund).

founders.name: Hayden Adams
founders.origin: United States (born October 21, 1992). B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Stony Brook University (2016).
founders.background: Researcher at Columbia University Medical Center. Engineer at Siemens (heat flow simulations). Laid off from Siemens in July 2017. A college friend at the Ethereum Foundation convinced him to learn Solidity. Built and launched Uniswap in November 2018.
founders.latest_projects: Uniswap v4 launched on mainnet January 31, 2025 (10 blockchains, hooks for custom pool logic). Unichain launched (processing ~$100B annualized DEX volume). UNIfication proposal passed December 2025: 100M UNI token burn, protocol fee activation. Over $1T lifetime trading volume.

founders.name: Kash Dhanda
founders.origin: Grew up in Wexford, Pennsylvania, USA. South Asian (Indian) heritage. Attended Washington University in St. Louis (B.A. in Political Philosophy). Currently based in Dubai.
founders.background: Founded Ezra Digital (design/marketing agency). Worked with Fortune 500 companies across Asia at LUMA Institute. Co-founded SuperteamDAO in October 2021 with Akshay BD for the Solana ecosystem.
founders.latest_projects: As COO of Jupiter Exchange, oversaw Jupiter's $35M strategic deal with ParaFi Capital. Spearheaded Jupiter Lend ($1B supply in 8 days), DTF platform, JupNet omnichain network, Polymarket integration on Solana, and Jupiter Global (payments). Hosted CatLumpurr conference (Jan-Feb 2026).

founders.name: Xiao-Xiao Zhu
founders.nationality: Unknown (educated in Germany, UK; career in Europe and Asia)
founders.origin: Educational ties to Germany and the UK. Studied at Humboldt University Berlin, Berlin University of Arts (Concert Piano), and London School of Economics (MSc).
founders.background: Professional concert pianist in Europe and Asia for 12+ years. Transitioned to business consulting at BCG, then General Manager at BCG Digital Ventures in London. Joined KKR in 2021 as Operating Partner / Digital Innovation & Blockchain Lead.
founders.latest_projects: Appointed as President of Jupiter Exchange. Overseeing Jupiter's expansion as Solana's largest full-stack DeFi platform ($3B+ TVL, $1T+ annualized trading volume).

founders.name: Júlia Bán
founders.background: CFO at SwissBorg. Degree from WU Vienna (2017-2019). Previously at Bitpanda.

founders.name: Cyrus Fazel
founders.origin: Born in Washington D.C. to Swiss-German and Iranian parents. Raised in New York and San Francisco. Swiss nationality.
founders.background: B.A. in International Business Management from EDHEC Business School. B.S. in Finance from International Business School. 10+ years in asset management and algorithmic trading. Founded SwissBorg in June 2016.
founders.latest_projects: SwissBorg suffered a $41M SOL theft in September 2025 via partner API compromise (CEO committed to full user compensation). Launched Withdrawal Protection in February 2026. Obtained new license for managed portfolios.

founders.name: Julia Ban
founders.origin: Name suggests Hungarian origin. Based in Vienna, Austria. Attended WU (Vienna University of Economics and Business), 2017-2019.
founders.background: Held previous roles at Bitpanda (major Austrian crypto exchange) before joining SwissBorg.
founders.latest_projects: Serves as CFO at SwissBorg, the European crypto wealth management platform available in 47 countries and 16 currencies.

founders.name: Were Meow
founders.background: Pseudonymous founder/CEO of Jupiter, leading Solana DEX aggregator (80%+ of DEX trades). Co-founded with Siong Ong Oct 2021. Previously co-founded WBTC, advised Blockfolio/Kyber. Co-founded Mercurial Finance (now Meteora).

founders.name: Meow (pseudonym)
founders.nationality: Singaporean (likely; grew up in Singapore, Mandarin-speaking)
founders.location: Unknown (pseudonymous; grew up in Singapore, lived in US)
founders.origin: Pseudonymous founder. Real identity and nationality are not publicly disclosed.
founders.background: Co-founded Mercurial Finance in early 2021 alongside Ben Chow. Then co-founded Jupiter in October 2021 with Siong Ong as a DEX aggregator on Solana, which rapidly captured ~95% of Solana's aggregator market share.
founders.latest_projects: Jupiter grew to $3B+ TVL, consistently top 3 DeFi protocol on Solana. Acquired Moonshot, SonarWatch, and DRiP Haus. Launched JupUSD stablecoin (Q4 2025), converting $750M+ from JLP pool. Integrated Polymarket on Solana. Announced Jupnet omnichain network. 50% of protocol fees used for token buybacks.

founders.name: Richard Teng
founders.background: Accounting degree from Nanyang Technological University. M.S. in Applied Finance from University of Western Australia. Executive Leadership Programme from Wharton. 30-year career in financial regulation. 13 years at the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS). Chief Regulatory Officer at Singapore Exchange (SGX). CEO of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) for 6 years. Named Binance CEO in November 2023 replacing CZ.
founders.latest_projects: Grew Binance from 170M to 300M users with $34T trading volume in 2025. Converted $1B of SAFU fund stablecoin reserves into Bitcoin (January 2026). Exploring tokenized securities and RWA trading through UAE framework.

founders.name: Suryaganesh Sastry
founders.origin: Indian. Educated at IIT Bombay (Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management). Company headquartered in London, UK.
founders.background: Vice President at Motilal Oswal Securities, Director at True North Co. and Ask to Solve, earlier positions at GE India Technology Centre, WNS, TG Kirloskar Automotive, and Toyoda Gosei India. Co-founded Kelp in 2022 with Shyaam Subramanian.
founders.latest_projects: Kelp is the second-largest Liquid Restaking Token (rsETH) on Ethereum with over $2B TVL. Now part of the KernelDAO ecosystem. Multi-chain expansion of rsETH to Layer 2s. Analysts predict $5B TVL by Q3 2026.

founders.name: Kirill Kutakov
founders.background: Graduated from the University of Warwick (Warwick Business School) with a BSc in Accounting and Finance (2014) and a BSc in Philosophy, Politics, and Economics (2017). Worked as an equity analyst in Scandinavia before co-founding StakeWise with Dmitri Tsumak in 2020.
founders.latest_projects: StakeWise continues its V3 protocol for permissionless liquid staking on Ethereum and Gnosis Chain with Vault-based architecture and osETH liquid staking token.

founders.name: Terry Huang
founders.origin: Taiwanese. Based in Taipei. Educated at Tamkang University (MSc in Physics), Taiwan.
founders.background: Former Regional Manager at Binance and Strategic Director at Chainnews before co-founding Lista DAO as COO.
founders.latest_projects: Lista DAO hit an all-time high TVL of over $4.5B in 2025 (179% year-over-year growth) and commands nearly 50% of BNB Chain's staking market. Plans for 2026 include Ethereum mainnet expansion and RWA integration.

founders.name: Toru Watanabe
founders.origin: Japanese. Limited public biographical information available.
founders.background: Known as the Co-Founder and CEO of Lista DAO (formerly Helio Protocol).
founders.latest_projects: Under his leadership, Lista DAO reached $4.5B ATH TVL in 2025. Launched Smart Lending, native Swap, and Fixed-Rate Borrowing products.

founders.name: Christopher Matta
founders.origin: American. Based in New York area.
founders.background: Attended The College of New Jersey. Spent six years at Goldman Sachs in wealth management, reaching Vice President (2012-2017). Co-founded Crescent Crypto Asset Management. Previously helped launch the first Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs in North America.
founders.latest_projects: Joined Liquid Collective as CEO. Galaxy Digital acquired Alluvial Finance in December 2025 and now serves as development partner. The protocol tripled assets to approximately $1B in 2025. Expanding into Solana liquid staking (LsSOL).

founders.name: Thomas Chen
founders.origin: American. Attended Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology (Virginia). BSc in Commerce from University of Virginia.
founders.background: Served as Managing Director and Global Head of Sales at BitGo, scaling it to $100B+ in assets under custody and $30B in staked assets.
founders.latest_projects: CEO of Function (rebranded from Ignition FBTC in February 2025). FBTC has $1.3B+ TVL. Raised $10M seed round led by Galaxy Digital. Part of Mantle's six core innovation pillars.

founders.name: Ryan Chow
founders.origin: Chinese. Educated at Beijing Foreign Studies University. Based in Singapore.
founders.background: Financial Analyst at Singularity Financial in Hong Kong (2018-2019). Previously co-founded Beijing Youzan Technology. Founded Solv Protocol in December 2020.
founders.latest_projects: Solv Protocol manages $1.18B+ in total assets. Launched SolvBTC with 467K unique addresses. Introduced BTC+ automated yield vault. Secured EU MiCA registration in January 2026.

founders.name: Jacob Phillips
founders.origin: American. BSc in Economics and Computer Science from Case Western Reserve University (2015-2019).
founders.background: Entered crypto in 2018. Joined Polychain Capital in 2020 as an investor (involved in BadgerDAO investments). Co-founded Lombard in 2024.
founders.latest_projects: LBTC reached $1.5B+ TVL (hit $1B in 92 days). Launched BARD governance token at $450M valuation (1,400% oversubscribed). Integrated with Ledger Wallet. Acquired BTC.b from Ava Labs.

founders.name: Michael Bentley
founders.background: PhD in Mathematical Biology from the University of Oxford. MSc in Computational Biology from Leeds. Postdoctoral research at Oxford, UCL, and Leeds. Earlier analyst at Royal Bank of Scotland. Co-founded Euler Labs in September 2020.
founders.latest_projects: Stepped down as CEO of Euler Labs in January 2026, moving to advisory and product-focused role. Jonathan Han (ex-The Tie) took over as CEO. Euler pivoting toward institutional vault infrastructure.

founders.name: Mark Dalton
founders.nationality: Canadian (likely; career started at BMO Capital Markets in Toronto)
founders.origin: Limited public information. **Note:** Convex Finance (the DeFi protocol built atop Curve/CRV) was created by pseudonymous founder(s) known as "C2tP." A "Mark Dalton" is Managing Director of ConvEx (a capital markets firm in London) -- appears to be a different entity. The DeFi Convex Finance team has remained anonymous since its May 2021 launch.
founders.background: See above -- identity/role distinction is unclear.
founders.latest_projects: Limited public information due to pseudonymous nature of the team.

founders.name: Gregory Prisco
founders.age_raw: ~36 (BS Villanova, career started ~2011 at Axiom Markets)
founders.background: Gregory Di Prisco, Co-Founder/Chief Architect at M^0 Labs. BS Economics from Villanova. Former commodity futures trader at Axiom Markets. 4+ years Head of BD at Maker Foundation. Co-founder of Ajna Labs. M0 raised $40M Series B.

founders.name: Andrew Khang
founders.background: MBA from MIT Sloan School of Management. Prior career includes roles at Baker Hughes, HubSpot, and MIT.
founders.latest_projects: Serving as Deputy COO at M0 Foundation, supporting operational scaling as the platform powers custom stablecoins for MetaMask, Noble, Usual, KAST, and Playtron.

founders.name: Gregory Di Prisco
founders.origin: American. Based in New York. Attended Villanova University.
founders.background: Involved in cryptocurrency since 2010. Background in futures trading. Co-founded Distributed Capital Partners (one of earliest crypto VCs). Led business development at MakerDAO. Co-founded Ajna Labs. In 2023, co-founded M0 with Luca Prosperi.
founders.latest_projects: M0 raised $40M Series B (August 2025) led by Polychain and Ribbit Capital (total: ~$100M). Building "Layer Zero for stablecoins" with protocol-enforced reserve standards. Partnered with MetaMask for stablecoin launch. Noble launched $USDN using M0 infrastructure. Surpassed $300M aggregate stablecoin supply.

founders.name: Iulian Serban
founders.nationality: Danish-Romanian (born in Denmark to Romanian parents)
founders.background: PhD in Machine Learning from Universite de Montreal (2014-2019), working within the MILA AI lab. Led development of the Milabot conversational system with Amazon.
founders.latest_projects: Korbit Technologies is an AI tutoring platform backed by Khosla Ventures. Raised $11.3M total. ~34 employees. Focuses on AI-powered mentoring for developers.

founders.name: Ekaterina Kochmar
founders.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE (Assistant Professor at MBZUAI)
founders.origin: Russian origin. Studied at St. Petersburg State University, University of Tubingen, and University of Cambridge (PhD in NLP).
founders.background: Academic positions at Cambridge, University of Bath, and MBZUAI. Author of Manning NLP book.
founders.latest_projects: Co-Founder and Chief Science Officer at Korbit Technologies.

founders.name: Mathieu Germain
founders.background: MS in Deep Learning from Universite de Sherbrooke. Six years at Mila as Applied Research Scientist. Research Scientist at Enlitic. VP of AI at horoma AI.
founders.latest_projects: VP of Artificial Intelligence at Korbit AI since July 2024.

founders.name: Atichanan Pulges
founders.origin: Thai (Bangkok native). BSc from California State University-Fullerton. MEng from UCLA.
founders.background: 10+ years in investment banking including Goldman Sachs. Co-founded Coins.co.th. Co-founded Bitkub in February 2018.
founders.latest_projects: Bitkub dominates 90%+ of Thai crypto market. Planning IPO. Regional expansion to Laos and Cambodia. Bitkub Summit 2025 attracted 52,000+ attendees.

founders.name: Topp Srupsrisopa
founders.background: Topp Jirayut Srupsrisopa, Founder/Group CEO of Bitkub Capital. BEconSc Manchester (2008-2011), MPhil Economics Oxford (2011-2013). Founded Coins.co.th 2014 (sold to Gojek). Founded Bitkub 2018, Thailand's unicorn, 90%+ market share.

founders.name: Topp Jirayut Srupsrisopa
founders.origin: Thai. Primary school at Marlborough Boy's College (New Zealand). BEconSc from University of Manchester. MPhil in Economics from Oxford University.
founders.background: Financial consultant at Marquis Advisory Group (San Francisco). Financial analyst at Evotech Capital (China). Founded Coins.co.th in 2014. Founded Bitkub Capital Group Holdings in 2018, Thailand's first fintech unicorn.
founders.latest_projects: IPO planned on SET. Attended WEF 2026 in Davos. Expanding Bitkub to Laos and Cambodia. Won CEO of the Year at ACES Awards.

founders.name: Joseph Lubin
founders.background: BSE in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science from Princeton. VP of Technology in Private Wealth Management at Goldman Sachs. Co-founded Ethereum in 2014. Founded ConsenSys in 2015.
founders.latest_projects: Linea (Ethereum L2 zkEVM) launched its LINEA token, targeting Type 1 zkEVM by Q1 2026 and 5,000 TPS by Q2 2026. Confirmed MetaMask's MASK token is coming.

founders.name: Chris McKibbin
founders.origin: American, based in Brooklyn, New York. Attended Princeton University (BA) and Columbia Business School (MBA).
founders.background: Co-founded Digital Domain as CFO. SVP at EA Online, COO/CFO of Origin Systems Studio. Roles at IBM and Google. Co-founded PlayGrid.
founders.latest_projects: COO of ConsenSys and Linea.

founders.name: Cole D'Ambrosio
founders.origin: American. BSc in Accounting from Binghamton University. MBA in Corporate Finance from University of Florida.
founders.background: CPA-certified. Career at CSX and City of Atlantic Beach. Managed GridPlus spin-off finances at ConsenSys.
founders.latest_projects: CFO of both ConsenSys and Linea.

founders.name: Usman Shahid
founders.location: Unknown (BingX was founded in 2018 by Josh Lu in Singapore)
founders.origin: Limited public information. BingX was founded in 2018 by Josh Lu in Singapore.
founders.background: Limited public information.
founders.latest_projects: BingX has grown to 10M+ users worldwide. First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP (January 2026). Principal partner of Chelsea FC.

founders.name: Ezekiel James
founders.origin: Limited public information. No verifiable public records connect this individual to BingX.
founders.background: Limited public information.
founders.latest_projects: Limited public information.

founders.name: Jonathan Steinberg
founders.background: Attended The Wharton School (University of Pennsylvania). Began career at Bear Stearns M&A department (1986-1988). Founded WisdomTree in 1988. Previously founded Individual Investor Group Inc. EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2015. ETF.com Lifetime Achievement Award 2015.
founders.latest_projects: WisdomTree crypto AUM at $2.24B, tokenized assets at $770M (25x growth from 2024). CEO of the Year at 2025 Wealth Management Industry Awards. Expanded to Solana, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, and Stellar.

founders.name: Brian Mark

founders.background: IMPORTANT: Ali Vasaya is NOT the founder of flaunch. Flaunch was founded by a pseudonymous individual known as 'Caps', who previously worked on NFTX and co-founded FloorDAO. Caps' journey began in poker, discovered Ethereum around 2015, created a price tracking app in 2016, joined NFTX during DeFi summer 2020, created FloorDAO, then founded Flaunch using Uniswap v4 hooks. Flaunch emerged from the merger of FloorDAO and NFTX in 2024. The CSV data linking Ali Vasaya to flaunch is incorrect.
